# Modesto v1.0.0-alpha.1

Modesto 1.0.0-alpha.1 is the current public line: more stable and feature-rich
than the 0.3/0.4 GitHub builds, published so those installs can update in-app.

## Highlights

- **Public 1.0 alpha** — this is the hop from Early Modesto / New Foundation onto
  the 1.0 line, still an alpha, not a claim that every surface is finished.
- **In-app update from 0.3 and 0.4** — this release is GitHub Latest with
  `latest` and `modesto` updater manifests and the production desktop identity,
  so existing GitHub installs pick it up without a manual re-download.
- **Chats without a project** — start and send a chat without opening a folder;
  Work still needs a project.
- **Desktop environments** — Cursor-style right-panel list, header usage clock,
  and Grok as a first-class provider.

## Downloads

- **macOS Apple Silicon:** `Modesto-1.0.0-alpha.1-arm64.dmg`
- **macOS Intel:** `Modesto-1.0.0-alpha.1-x64.dmg`
- **Windows x64:** `Modesto-1.0.0-alpha.1-x64.exe`
- **Linux x64:** `Modesto-1.0.0-alpha.1-x86_64.AppImage`

The macOS `.zip`, updater manifests, and blockmaps support automatic updates.
This release also publishes the exact v1.0.0-alpha.1 source snapshot; local
environment files, credentials, and generated release/build directories are
excluded.
